        "text",
        "text_height",
        "length_factor"

        "ry*",
        "rotation",
        "start_angle",
        "end_angle"
      ],
      "draw_params": true
    },

        "points*",
        "text*",
        "text_height"
      ],
      "draw_params": true

      "op": "add_line",

      "params": [
        "start*",
        "end*"

        "text_height"

        "center*",
        "count*",
        "total_angle",
        "rotate_items"

        "cols*",

        "col_spacing"

        "line2*",
        "d1*",
        "d2"

        "delta",
        "base",
        "to",
        "count"

        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "if_exists"

        "height",
        "if_exists"
      ]

        "entities*",
        "attributes",
        "if_exists"

        "target*",
        "confirm_large"

      "op": "delete_layer",
      "category": "layer",
      "summary": "Delete a layer",
      "params": [
        "name*",
        "delete_entities"
      ]

      "op": "explode",
      "category": "edit",

      "params": [
        "target*"
      ]

        "edges*",
        "end"

        "line2*",

      "params": [
        "name*",
        "insert*",
        "scale",
        "rotation",
        "attributes"

      "params": [

        "p1*",
        "p2*",
        "keep_original"
      ]

        "set*"

        "base",
        "to"

        "distance*",
        "side_point"

      "draw_params": true

        "angle*",
        "center*"

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "factor*",
        "center*"
      ]

      "op": "set_attributes",

      "params": [
        "target*",
        "values*"
      ]
    },

      "op": "set_properties",
      "category": "edit",
      "summary": "Change layer / color / linetype / lineweight / tag of entities",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "layer",
        "color",
        "linetype",
        "lineweight",
        "tag"
      ]
    },

      "op": "stretch",

      "summary": "AutoCAD STRETCH with a crossing window: entities entirely inside move; LINE end points, polyline vertices and dimension definition points inside the window move; circles/arcs/text/blocks move if their center/insert point is inside",
      "params": [
        "window*",
        "delta*"
      ]
    },

      "summary": "AutoCAD TRIM: remove the part of the target (LINE, ARC or CIRCLE) that contains 'pick', bounded by its nearest intersections with the cutting edges",
      "params": [
        "target*",
        "edges*",
        "pick*"
      ]
    }
